hooks.name: core-boundary-guard
hooks.description: Fails when Wysp Core imports host or adapter code, or uses application vocabulary. Keeps the Core app-agnostic, which is the proof that both tutors share the same Core.

hooks.name: trust-review
hooks.description: Reviews changes to permission and trust code, adapter action files and extension/add-on manifests against the trust and safety rules.

action.prompt: You just changed a file related to permissions, adapter actions or extension/add-on permissions. Check the change against .kiro/steering/trust-and-safety.md before continuing: (1) every action declares a risk level, and every reversible action returns an undo token with a working undo; (2) no action evaluates code, scripts or shell commands; (3) nothing bypasses the permission gate or the provenance validator; (4) no token, API key or sensitive field value is logged or sent; (5) manifest permissions stay minimal (no new host or Blender permission without a reason written in the spec). If something violates these rules, fix it now and say what you changed. Otherwise continue without comment.

hooks.name: task-preflight
hooks.description: Before a spec task runs, reminds the agent of ownership, dependencies and the contract change process.

action.prompt: Before implementing this spec task: (1) re-read the requirements it references in requirements.md and the related section of design.md; (2) check ownership in .kiro/steering/structure.md: if the task changes files owned by another person or changes the adapter contract (core/src/wysp_core/contract, schemas/, sdk/), stop and ask the user to confirm that the contract change process is followed; (3) check that the earlier tasks it depends on are completed; (4) keep Wysp Core free of application-specific code; (5) write or update the tests listed in the task, including required property tests.
